items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: The interviewee discusses the Bruness family generally ('All the Brunesses had powerful tones') and confirms details about Henry Bruness, but does not explicitly state a personal interaction or specific relationship with Richie, who is primarily discussed by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Merritt Brunas? They have good trouble.
How was Richard? What's Richard? Richard Brunas. Richie. Richie. Richie. Well, Richie didn't come up. He was in the straight. He used to play with fishers.
Well, who was the very first corner player you ever heard? That's a question.
